metadata.description: Plugins for working with ymer.ax — one plugin per practice, its skills the practice's moves. Using any plugin requires a Ymer Node you run; a ymer.ax account and one version-controlled folder for state are each optional, and each is the default where a session reaches it. Install `setup` and run `/setup:env` to create what is missing and report what it found.

plugins.name: setup
plugins.description: One-time setup for the ymer marketplace — creates the store skeletons in your Ymer Node's notebook, checks the state folder and the ymer connection, creates the Meta Roadmap project, and checks all four again whenever you ask.

plugins.name: kaizen
plugins.description: Continuous improvement over your working process — capture frictions as you work, drain them into improvement work.
